items.description: A task to be executed as part of the function. Will first be compiled using the parent function's input. May be skipped or mapped.

tasks.description: The list of tasks to be executed as part of the function. Each will first be compiled using the parent function's input.

description: A scalar function defined inline. Each task's output expression must return a number in [0,1]. The function's output is the weighted average of all task outputs using profile weights. If there is only one task, its output becomes the function's output directly.
